title: Goggles Battery Warning
description: The goggles' own battery warning (on-screen message + buzzer) fires when pack voltage < cells x the per-cell voltage below. Lower thresholds are meant for Li-ion packs only. If you power your goggles with a LiPo or the original DJI battery, keep the stock setting so you are warned before discharging it too low.

per_cell_mv.title: Warn voltage per cell
per_cell_mv.description: Stock firmware uses 3.50 V/cell, which is conservative for Li-ion.

cells.title: Battery cells
cells.description: The goggles detect the cell count from the pack voltage when they start. A pack that is not fully charged can be detected with too few cells (e.g. a 4S pack below 12.9 V as 3S), which makes the warning fire far too late. Set your pack's cell count to avoid this.
